operationalRules: Independent diagnosis: record the classification system, version, diagnostic label and applicable code. Treat mappings as comparative unless equivalence has been established for the particular use case. Do not infer diagnosis from a code label or symptom checklist alone.

Clinical priority before prevalence: begin with immediate safety concerns, acute medical instability, delirium, intoxication or withdrawal and severe psychiatric symptoms. Tier numbers are organizational navigation aids, not validated prevalence claims.

Primary versus secondary etiology: diagnose a secondary or substance/medication-induced syndrome only when the required causal evidence exists. Substance-induced presentations use their substance-specific families; do not route all induced disorders to 6E6x.

Developmental classification and comorbidity: classify as neurodevelopmental only when developmental history and clinical features meet the relevant requirements. Developmental onset does not determine the principal diagnosis or reason for encounter.

Personality disorder assessment: establish ICD-11 personality disorder and severity first, then add trait-domain or pattern qualifiers. Borderline pattern is 6D11.5; 6D11.0 denotes Negative affectivity. A DSM categorical label has no automatic one-to-one ICD-11 equivalent.
Coding specificity: distinguish a parent family from a final assignable diagnosis; select valid child codes and qualifiers from the chosen release. Do not assume sequential code ranges exist.

Cross-chapter referencing: ICD-11 sleep-wake disorders are in Chapter 07, nervous-system diseases in Chapter 08, sexual dysfunctions and gender incongruence in Chapter 17, PMDD in Chapter 16. Chapter placement does not establish DSM diagnostic equivalence or billing compatibility.
Completeness: this dataset is a screening aid and does not enumerate every diagnosis, residual category, severity or course qualifier, exclusion or diagnostic requirement in either manual.
instrumentNotes: IPDE ICD-10 screening questionnaire implemented with keyed True/False items; app uses the single-item positive standard explicitly permitted by the instrument authors (printed standard: >=3 keyed items per disorder).

PDQ-4+ implemented with validity items 64/76, Section B item 98 (>=2 impulsivity checks gates Borderline) and item 99 (>=3 conduct checks gates Antisocial), plus the mandatory clinical-significance A-E follow-up checklist.
Personality instrument item text was transcribed from user-supplied scans; Hindi labels are machine-assisted aids flagged for clinician review. Verify licensing before redistribution.

STAXI-CA implemented as three printed parts (State Anger 1-15, Trait Anger 16-24, Anger Expression 25-57) with Anger-In/Anger-Out/Anger-Control/Denial subscale sums; item stems were transcribed from a user-supplied scan whose duplicated/garbled lines were reconciled against the canonical printed form (see scales.staxi_ca.sourceNotes).
Clinical Anger Scale (CAS) implemented as 21 four-option clusters scored A=0/B=1/C=2/D=3, summed 0-63 with the published interpretive bands (0-13 minimal, 14-19 mild, 20-28 moderate, 29-63 severe).

Anger instruments are dimensional/severity measures reached through the new 'anger' domain (routing auto:angertable); they gate no diagnostic box. STAXI-CA is a copyrighted PAR instrument — verify licensing before redistribution.

Dissociation instruments implemented as scales.mid60 (Multidimensional Inventory of Dissociation 60-item short form; index = mean of 60 ratings x 10 with printed score ranges and 12 subscale clinical cutoffs) and scales.desii (Dissociative Experiences Scale II; 28 percentage items, total = mean, clinical comparison point >= 30). Reached through the new 'dissociation' domain via routing auto:dissociationtable; both are self-report dimensional screening measures and gate no diagnostic box.

MID-60 short-form reference: Kate, Jamieson, Dorahy & Middleton (2021), Journal of Trauma & Dissociation 22(3), 265-287. Two printed subscale-key anomalies (body-symptom item 21 vs trance item 21 duplication) are documented in scales.mid60.sourceNotes instead of being silently corrected. The full 253-item MID is copyrighted — verify licensing before redistribution.

MID-60 items 22, 37, 44, 56 and 58 (persecutory/degrading voices, waking with means of self-harm) and DES-II item 27 (command/commentary voices) carry safety flags that open the crisis pathway when rated above zero.

FAC22-SR: added from the published scale table (Senthil & Prabhakar, J Evid Based Med Healthc 2019;6(21) Table 7). English wording is authoritative and was repaired from the scan; Hindi labels are a working translation awaiting bilingual-clinician proofreading. Keying verified at build time: Yes to 5, 8, 10, 11, 14-22 and No to 1-4, 6, 7, 9, 12, 13 = 22 items. Screening only - never diagnostic; factitious disorder additionally requires exclusion of malingering (see reference.malingering).

PHQ-15: 15-item somatic symptom severity index (0-2 each, total 0-30) added as a tier-2 optional screen reached from the `somatic` domain; bands follow the printed cut-points 0-4 / 5-9 / 10-14 / 15+. Severity measure that supplements clinical judgement.

GCLS implemented as scales.gcls (Gender Congruence and Life Satisfaction Scale; 38 items rated Never=0 to Always=4 over the past 6 months, plus one non-scored genital-surgery tick-box linked to item 26). Four subscales with reverse-keyed positively worded items (16, 20, 22, 30 congruence; 35, 37 negative satisfaction): functional impact 1-13, body preoccupation 14/15/17/18/19/21/23/24/26/27/28/29, social preoccupation 16/20/22/30, life satisfaction 31-38 reported separately (higher = more satisfied). Reached through the new 'gender' domain via routing auto:genderdistress. Items 8 and 13 are safety-flagged (chest/genital self-harm and suicidal ideation) and open the crisis pathway. Dimensional screen only — it never diagnoses gender incongruence, and gender diversity alone is not a disorder.

BISS implemented as scales.biss (Bipolar Inventory of Signs and Symptoms Scale, Bowden v1.5 4/1/08): 44 clinician-rated items scored 0-4 over the most recent 7 days, each with its own printed verbal anchors, item definition and probe questions. Depression section items 1-20 (0-80), Mania section items 21-44 (0-96); an item counts as symptomatic at >= 2. Dimensional severity measure with no diagnostic cutoff - the score never produces a bipolar diagnosis, it describes severity and change. Reached through the mood domain via routing auto:bipolartable. Items 4 (suicidality), 25 (aggression), 39 (risky behaviour) and 43 (hallucinations) are safety-flagged.

HEXACO-PI-R Observer Report Form implemented as scales.hexaco_pi_r_observer (60 informant-rated items, 1-5 scale, 24 facets across 6 domains, R items reverse-scored, facet/domain means reported on the 1-5 metric). Descriptive profile only - no diagnostic cut-offs. Item wording and the scoring key are those published by Lee & Ashton; confirm licensing terms for the deployment setting.

name.en: Forensic reference: malingering, feigning & suspect effort
name.hi: फॉरेंसिक संदर्भ: मालिंगरिंग, छल-अभिनय एवं संदेहजनक प्रयास

malingering.source: Supplied forensic-handbook extract (res ipsa / malingering evaluation notes)

items.en: Malingering (DSM-5): intentional production of false or grossly exaggerated physical or psychological symptoms motivated by external incentives — avoiding military duty, avoiding work, obtaining financial compensation, evading criminal prosecution, obtaining drugs.
items.hi: मालिंगरिंग (DSM-5): बाह्य प्रलोभन (सैनिक सेवा से बचाव, कार्य से बचाव, आर्थिक क्षतिपूर्ति, दंड से बचाव, मादक द्रव्य प्राप्ति) हेतु शारीरिक/मानसिक लक्षणों का जानबूझकर मिथ्या या अत्यधिक वर्धन।

items.en: Feigning: deliberate fabrication or gross exaggeration of symptoms without assumptions about its goals (Rogers & Bender, 2003).
items.hi: छल-अभिनय: लक्ष्य संबंधी पूर्वधारणा के बिना लक्षणों का जानबूझकर निर्माण या अत्यधिक वर्धन (Rogers & Bender, 2003)।

items.en: Suspect effort: effort-test performance suggesting the examinee is not applying best effort; may be intentional or non-intentional (also suboptimal/incomplete/submaximal effort).
items.hi: संदेहजनक प्रयास: परीक्षार्थी द्वारा सर्वोत्तम प्रयास न लगाने का संकेत; सचेत या असचेत हो सकता है (उप-इष्टतम/अपूर्ण/उप-अधिकतम प्रयास)।

items.en: Factitious disorder: voluntary production of symptoms to assume the patient role, with no other obvious secondary gain.
items.hi: छलरोग: रोगी-भूमिका अपनाने हेतु लक्षणों की स्वेच्छा-उत्पत्ति,अन्य कोई सुगम्य द्वितीयक लाभ के बिना।

items.en: Ganser syndrome: approximate answers (2+2=5), clouding of consciousness, somatic conversion (especially sensory), hallucinations.
items.hi: गैंसर सिंड्रोम: अनुमानोत्तर (2+2=5), चेतना की मंदता, शारीरिक कन्वर्ज़न (विशेषतः संवेदी), एवं Hallucination।

items.en: Gervais et al. (2001): 25-30% of civil-litigation claimants of major depression probably malingered on forced-choice testing.
items.hi: Gervais आदि (2001): दीवानी वादों में प्रस्तावित प्रमुख अवसाद के 25-30% दाता संभवतः फोर्सड-चॉइस परीक्षण पर मालिंगरिंग कर रहे थे।

items.en: Review DSM-5 criteria first; then weigh inconsistency between reported state and observed behaviour: full range of facial expression, normal motor activity, laughing/joking, enjoyment of activities, no verifiable weight change, indiscriminate endorsement of unrelated symptoms, laudatory self-presentation, blame of others, poor performance on very easy personal questions, sudden worsening once told they will be 'tested', mood change when observed vs unobserved.
items.hi: प्रथम DSM-5 मानदंड देखें; फिर वर्णित अवस्था एवं प्रत्यक्ष व्यवहार की विसंगति पर विचार: भाव-अभिव्यक्ति का पूर्ण विस्तार, सामान्य मोटर क्रिया, हँसी-मज़ाक, कार्यों में रूचि, वजन-परिवर्तन का अप्रमाणित, असंबंधित लक्षणों का अंधाधुंध समर्थन, स्व-प्रशंसा, दूसरों पर दोषारोपण, अत्यंत सरल व्यक्तिगत प्रश्नों पर खराब प्रदर्शन, 'परीक्षण' बताते ही स्मरण/एकाग्रता का आकस्मिक अवमदन, प्रेक्षित अप्रत्यक्ष अवस्था में अंतर।

items.en: Start open-ended ('Describe what you are hearing. Is there anything else you can describe?'); avoid educating the evaluee about expected signs — 'clinician assisted deception'.
items.hi: प्रथम खुले प्रश्न ('जो सुनाई दे उसका वर्णन करें। और कुछ?'); अपेक्षित लक्षणों की शिक्षा न दें — इसे 'चिकित्सक-सहायताप्राप्त छल' कहते हैं।

items.en: Phenomenology to document: content, clarity, loudness, vividness, duration, frequency, continuous/intermittent, single/multiple voices, gender, inside/outside the head, tone, person addressed, insight, belief others can hear, relationship to speaker, other sensory modalities, alone/with others, conversing back, ability to dismiss, mood, relation to delusions, confusion, reaction, commands, consequences of disobeying, effort not to obey, alternative motives, what worsens/improves, number of voices.
items.hi: अभिलिखित घटना-विज्ञान: विषय, स्पष्टता, प्रबलता, व्यक्तता, काल, आवृत्ति, सतत/विविक्त, एक/अनेक स्वर, लिंग, मस्तिष्क के अंतः/बहिः, ध्वनि-स्वर, संबोधन, अंतर्दृष्टि, अन्यको श्रवण-विश्वास, वक्ता-संबंध, अन्य इंद्रिय-द्वारा, एकांत/समूह, उत्तर-दान, निवारण-समर्थता, भाव, भ्रम-संबंध, विषमता, प्रतिक्रिया, आदेश, अवमान्यता के परिणाम, अवमान्य इच्छा, वैकल्पिक प्रेरणा, वर्धन-हेतु, संख्या।

items.en: In genuine psychosis voices are usually intermittent; Nayani & David (1996): 49% external, 38% internal, 12% both; abuse the commonest content; 76% identify at least one coping strategy (working, posture change, interpersonal contact, medication); being alone worsens voices in 80%, radio/TV worsen them.
items.hi: वास्तविक मनोविकृति में स्वर प्रायः विविक्त; Nayani और David (1996): 49% बाह्य, 38% आंतरिक, 12% उभय; गाली सबसे सामान्य; 76% कम-से-कम एक सामना-रणनीति बताते हैं (कार्य, मुद्रा-परिवर्तन, संपर्क, औषधि); 80% में एकांत से वृद्धि, रेडियो/टीवी से भी वर्धन।

items.en: Suspect auditory hallucinations: continuous rather than intermittent, vague/inaudible, not associated with delusions, stilted language, no strategies to diminish voices, claim that all commands are obeyed.
items.hi: संदेहजनक श्रवण-भ्रम: सतत बजाय विविक्त, अस्पष्ट/अश्रव्य, भ्रम से असंबद्ध, कृत्रिम भाषा, स्वर-निवारण की कोई रणनीति नहीं, समस्त आदेश-पालन का दावा।

items.en: Suspect visual hallucinations: visual alone in schizophrenia, black-and-white, dramatic/atypical, changing with eyes closed, miniature or giant figures, visions unrelated to delusions or auditory hallucinations. (Visual hallucinations were found in 46% of malingerers vs 4% of genuinely psychotic individuals; drug-induced visual phenomena are typically formed with eyes closed.)
items.hi: संदेहजनक दृष्टि-भ्रम: स्किज़ोफ्रेनिया में केवल दृष्टि, श्वेत-श्याम, नाटकीय/असामान्य, नेत्र-बंद करने पर परिवर्तन, लीलिपुटियन/विराट आकृतियाँ, भ्रम-असंबद्ध दर्शन। (मालिंगरेटर्स में 46% बनाम वास्तविक मनोविकृतों में 4% दृष्टि-भ्रम; मादक-प्रेरित दृष्टि-घटनाएँ प्रायः नेत्र-बंद अवस्था में।)

items.en: Delusion: a fixed false belief held in an inappropriate context with inappropriate justification.
items.hi: भ्रम: अपोचित संदर्भ एवं अपोचित उचितकरण के साथ स्थिर मिथ्या विश्वास।

items.en: Common themes: disease, nihilism/poverty/sin/guilt, grandiosity, jealousy, erotomania, persecution, reference, religion, poisoning, possession, royal descent, delusional parasitosis, Capgras syndrome.
items.hi: सामान्य विषय: रोग, शून्यता/दरिद्रता/पाप/अपराध-भाव, वैभवंशा, ईर्ष्या, प्रणय-भ्रम, उत्पीड़न, संदर्भ, धर्म, विष-प्रयोग, ग्रहण, राजवंश-वंशज, भ्रामक परजीविता, कैपग्रस।

items.en: Clues to malingered delusions: abrupt onset or termination, eagerness to call attention to the delusion, conduct inconsistent with the delusion, bizarre content without disordered thought, delusions paired with exaggerated cognitive deficit.
items.hi: छल-संकेत: आकस्मिक आरंभ/अंत, भ्रम पर ध्यान खींचने की उत्सुकता, भ्रम-असंगत व्यवहार, विचार-विकृति के बिना विचित्र विषय, अतिरंजित संज्ञान-क्षति के साथ भ्रम।

items.en: First clarify that the complaint is amnesia rather than dementia/delirium/developmental memory difficulty; a memory evaluation covers orientation, recall of prose, rote learning, visuospatial retention, remote memory/fund of information and autobiographical memory, with medical work-up (labs, neuro exam, imaging) as indicated.
items.hi: प्रथम स्पष्ट करें कि शिकायत स्मृतिलोप है, मूर्छा/डीमेंशिया/विकास-जनित स्मरण-कठिनाई नहीं; मूल्यांकन में दिशा-काल ज्ञान, गद्य-स्मरण, रट-अध्ययन, दृश्य-स्थानिक धारणा, सुदूर स्मरण/सूचना-भंडार एवं आत्मकथात्मक स्मरण, तथा आवश्यक चिकित्सीय जाँच।

items.en: Organic causes to consider: substance use, anterior communicating artery aneurysm rupture, anoxia, brain disease/injury, cerebrovascular accident, delirium, dementia, ECT, encephalitis, hypoglycaemia, somnambulism, transient epileptic amnesia, Wernicke-Korsakoff syndrome.
items.hi: कारणात्मक जैविक कारण: मादक द्रव्य, ACoA एनेवरिज्म भंग, अनॉक्सिया, मस्तिष्क रोग/आघात, CVA, delirium, डीमेंशिया, ECT, एन्सेफलाइटिस, हाइपोग्लाइसीमिया, स्लीप-वॉकिंग, क्षणिक मृगवानीय स्मृतिलोप, Wernicke-Korsakoff।

items.en: Ribot's law: after head trauma older memories return before recent ones, with the gap limited to the event and seconds beforehand; recovery that does not follow this pattern warrants screening for malingering.
items.hi: राइबोट-नियम: मस्तिष्क-आघात पश्चात् पुरानी स्मृतियाँ नवीन से पूर्व लौटती हैं, अंतराल घटना एवं उसके कुछ क्षण पूर्व तक सीमित; इस पैटर्न से हटने वाली पुनर्प्राप्ति पर मालिंगरिंग-स्क्रीन आवश्यक।

items.en: Patterns consistent with malingered amnesia: circumscribed loss for the offence with recall before and after; sharp sudden onset and offset; complete loss for a circumscribed period (complete amnesia for a criminal act is very rare); dogmatic belief that nothing could aid recovery; overly dramatic presentation; implausibly precise time window; attributing amnesia to intoxication contrary to available evidence.
items.hi: मालिंगरिंग-संगत पैटर्न: केवल अपराध-काल की सीमित हानि, पूर्व-पश्चात् स्मरण; आकस्मिक आरंभ-अंत; सीमित काल का पूर्ण लोप (अपराध का पूर्ण अमांसिया अत्यंत दुर्लभ); किसी सहायता से स्मरण-पुनर्प्राप्ति का अडंबरहीन अविश्वास; अत्यंत नाटकीय प्रस्तुति; अविश्वसनीय रूप से सटीक समय-सीमा; प्रमाण-विरुद्ध मतवैषम्य को हेतु बताना।

items.en: Alcohol/substance claims: over half (and in some studies >85%) of offenders claiming amnesia were intoxicated near the offence, but intoxication sufficient to produce genuine amnesia is uncommon — do not accept the claim without corroborating levels/evidence.
items.hi: मदिरा/मादक दावे: अमांसिया-दाता अपराधियों में अर्धे से अधिक (कुछ अध्ययनों में >85%) नशे में थे, किंतु वास्तविक अमांसिया उत्पन्न करने योग्य मात्रा दुर्लभ — प्रमाण-राशि के बिना दावा स्वीकार न करें।

items.en: Planning matters: instrumental (planned) offences involve elaborative encoding and rehearsal, which improve memory, so genuine amnesia for planned violence is unexpected; impulsive/reactive offences may be followed by partial retrograde gaps.
items.hi: योजना-प्रसंग: सयोजित (योजनाबद्ध) अपराधों में विस्तृत एनकोडिंग-अभ्यास स्मरण बढ़ाता है, अतः योजनाबद्ध हिंसा का वास्तविक अमांसिया अप्रत्याशित; आवेगजनित अपराधों में आंशिक पश्चगामी अंतराल संभव।

items.en: Self-report dissociation instruments (DES/DES-II, MID) rely entirely on self-report: a high score does not prove claimed memory loss is genuine (McLeod 2004; Woodworth 2009 — DES tendency correlated with perceived, not objective, memory impairment).
items.hi: स्व-रिपोर्ट वियोजन मापनियाँ (DES/DES-II, MID) पूर्णतः स्व-रिपोर्ट पर निर्भर: उच्च अंक दावा-कृत स्मृतिलोप की प्रामाणिकता सिद्ध नहीं करता (McLeod 2004; Woodworth 2009)।

title.en: Pathway to homicidal violence (Calhoun & Weston 2003; steps 7-8 per Christianson et al. 2007)
title.hi: हत्याकांड-हेतु हिंसा की पथ-रेखा (Calhoun और Weston 2003; चरण 7-8 Christianson आदि 2007)

items.en: Step 1 Grievance — anger, revenge, feeling wronged.
items.hi: चरण 1 शिकायत — क्रोध, प्रतिशोध, अन्याय-भाव।

items.en: Step 2 Ideation — accepting violence to right the wrong or fulfil violent/sexual fantasies; identifying with other assailants.
items.hi: चरण 2 विचारधारा — अन्याय-सुधार या हिंसक/यौन कल्पना हेतु हिंसा स्वीकार; अन्य आक्रमणकारियों से तादात्म्य।

items.en: Step 3 Research and planning — gathering information, inquiring about the target, surveillance.
items.hi: चरण 3 अनुसंधान-योजना — सूचना-संग्रह, लक्ष्य-पूछताछ, निगरानी।

items.en: Step 4 Preparations — assembling equipment, practising, choosing clothing, writing messages, making a will.
items.hi: चरण 4 पूर्वतैयारी — उपकरण-संग्रह, अभ्यास, वस्त्र-चयन, संदेश-लेखन, वसीयत।

items.en: Step 5 Breach — positioning oneself close to the potential victim.
items.hi: चरण 5 प्रवेश — संभावित शिकार के निकट स्थितिग्रहण।

items.en: Step 6 Attack — enacting the plan, requiring commitment and resolve.
items.hi: चरण 6 आक्रमण — योजना-क्रियान्वयन, संकल्प-आवश्यकता।

items.en: Step 7 Realisation — actions upon the victim's body, additional violence or sexual acts.
items.hi: चरण 7 साक्षात्कार — शरीर पर क्रियाएँ, अतिरिक्त हिंसा/यौन कृत्य।

items.en: Step 8 Post-crime behaviour — behaviours aimed at avoiding discovery or staging the scene.
items.hi: चरण 8 अपराधोत्तर व्यवहार — पकड़े जाने से बचाव अथवा घटना-स्थल की रचना।

Not diagnostic.

description.en: 57-item anger inventory in three printed parts: State Anger (items 1-15, 'how you feel right now'), Trait Anger (items 16-24, 'how you generally feel') and Anger Expression (items 25-57, split into Anger-In, Anger-Out, Anger Control and Denial). Each item is rated 1-4; raw sums are reported per subscale (State 15-60, Trait 16-36, each expression/control scale 10-40, Denial 2-8). Dimensional only — not diagnostic.
description.hi: तीन-भाग 57-आइटम क्रोध-सूची: अवस्था क्रोध (1-15, 'अभी कैसे महसूस'), लक्षण क्रोध (16-24, 'सामान्यतः कैसे महसूस') एवं क्रोध-अभिव्यक्ति (25-57; Anger-In, Anger-Out, क्रोध-नियंत्रण, अस्वीकरण)। प्रत्येक आइटम 1-4 रेटेड; उप-पैमाने अनुसार कच्चे योग (अवस्था 15-60, लक्षण 16-36, प्रत्येक अभिव्यक्ति/नियंत्रण 10-40, अस्वीकरण 2-8)। केवल आयामात्मक — रोग-निर्णायक नहीं।

description.en: 21-cluster, four-option (A-D) self-report measure of clinical anger; A=0, B=1, C=2, D=3 summed across clusters for a total range of 0-63. Interpretive ranges: 0-13 minimal, 14-19 mild, 20-28 moderate, 29-63 severe clinical anger (Snell et al., 1995). Screens severity only — not diagnostic.
description.hi: नैदानिक क्रोध का 21-समूह, चार-विकल्प (A-D) स्व-वर्णित माप; A=0, B=1, C=2, D=3 समूहों में जोड़कर शीर्घ 0-63। व्याख्या-परिसर: 0-13 न्यूनतम, 14-19 हल्का, 20-28 मध्यम, 29-63 गंभीर नैदानिक क्रोध (Snell et al., 1995)। केवल तीव्रता स्क्रीन — रोग-निर्णायक नहीं।

name.en: Multidimensional Inventory of Dissociation — MID-60 (short form)

description.en: 60-item dissociative-experience inventory rated 0-10 (never → always) when not intoxicated. Index = mean of all 60 responses x 10 (0-100) with printed score ranges (0-7 none; 7-14 few; 15-20 mild; 21-30 may have DD/PTSD; 31-40 may have DD such as OSDD-1/DID; 41-64 probably DID or severe DD; 64+ severe). Twelve subscales carry individual clinical cutoffs (DID amnesia 10; alter awareness 20; angry intrusions 18; persecutory intrusions 18; D/DD 20; amnesia distress 30; autobiographical amnesia 34; PTSD flashbacks 16; conversion body symptoms 10; pseudo-seizures 10; trance 11.7; self-confusion 33.3). Screening/severity only — not diagnostic.
description.hi: 60-आइटम वियोजीय-अनुभव सूची, नशे में न रहते हुए 0-10 (कभी नहीं → सदैव) रेटेड। सूचकांक = सभी 60 उत्तरों का माध्य × 10 (0-100), मुद्रित स्कोर-परिसर सहित। बारह उप-पैमानों पर पृथक नैदानिक कटऑफ (DID क्षतिस्मृति 10; अंश-बोध 20; क्रोधित प्रवेश 18; उत्पीड़नकारी प्रवेश 18; D/DD 20; क्षतिस्मृति-कष्ट 30; आत्मकथात्मक क्षतिस्मृति 34; PTSD फ्लैशबैक 16; परिवर्तन शारीरिक लक्षण 10; छद्म-दौरे 10; ट्रांस 11.7; स्व-विभ्रम 33.3)। केवल स्क्रीनिंग/तीव्रता — रोग-निर्णायक नहीं।

format.en: 44 items rated 0-4 by the clinician from self-report, family and interview observation; two sections (Depression 1-20, Mania 21-44)
format.hi: 44 आइटम, चिकित्सक द्वारा 0-4; दो विभाग (अवसाद 1-20, उन्माद 21-44)

purpose.en: Quantify severity of bipolar signs and symptoms and track change; supports staging of an episode and treatment monitoring. Not diagnostic.
purpose.hi: द्विध्रुवी लक्षणों की तीव्रता मापना एवं परिवर्तन-निगरानी; अवस्था-प्रबंधन व चिकित्सा-निगरानी में सहायक। रोग-निर्णायक नहीं।

construct.hi: Six-domain personality structure rated by an informant

format.en: 60 कथन, मूल्यांकन-विषय के विषय में 1 (पूर्णतः असहमत) से 5 (पूर्णतः सहमत) पर रेटित; 6 डोमेनों में 24 फलक-पैमाने; R-कुंजी आइटम व्युक्रम-अंकित; फलक = उसके आइटमों का माध्य, डोमेन = उसके फलकों का माध्य
format.hi: 60 statements rated 1 (strongly disagree) to 5 (strongly agree) about the person being described; 24 facet scales across 6 domains; R-keyed items reverse-scored; facet = mean of its items, domain = mean of its facets

language.en: Hindi working translation; English original authoritative
language.hi: हिन्दी कार्यशील अनुवाद; अंग्रेज़ी मूल प्राधिकृत

purpose.en: व्यक्ति को अच्छी तरह जानने वाले से व्यक्ति-ता-प्रोफाइल प्राप्त करना — आत्म-रिपोर्ट की पुष्टि/चुनौती एवं रूपरेखा में पर्यवेक्षक-स्तर की सूचना जोड़ना। केवल वर्णनात्मक — कोई नैदानिक कटऑफ नहीं।
purpose.hi: Obtain a personality profile from someone who knows the person well, to corroborate or challenge self-report and add observer-level information to the formulation. Descriptive only - it carries no diagnostic cut-offs.

licensing.en: Item wording and scoring key published freely by the authors; commercial or redistributed use requires their permission.
licensing.hi: मूल रूप व स्कोरिंग-कुंजी लेखकों द्वारा मुक्त-उपयोग हेतु प्रकाशित; व्यावसायिक/पुनर्विक्रय उपयोग हेतु अनुमति आवश्यक।

depression_mdd.mappingNote: ICD-11 distinguishes episode count: Single episode depressive disorder is 6A70, Recurrent depressive disorder is 6A71. DSM Major Depressive Disorder maps to whichever applies; the parent block is 6A7Z if unspecified.

description.en: Persistent sadness, loss of interest, and functional impairment lasting at least 2 weeks
description.hi: कम से कम 2 सप्ताह तक चलने वाली लगातार उदासी, रुचि की हानि, और कार्यात्मक हानि

description.en: Chronic depressed mood lasting at least 2 years
description.hi: कम से कम 2 साल तक चलने वाला पुराना अवसादग्रस्त मूड

depression_persistent.mappingNote: ICD-11 Dysthymic disorder is 6A72; 6A80 is the symptomatic/course presentations block for mood episodes, not a persistent mood-disorder family.

description.en: Excessive worry about multiple things for at least 6 months
description.hi: कम से कम 6 महीने तक कई चीजों के बारे में अत्यधिक चिंता

gad.mappingNote: ICD-11 Generalised anxiety disorder is 6B00; 6B02 is Agoraphobia.

description.en: Marked fear or anxiety about situations where escape might be difficult or help unavailable
description.hi: ऐसी स्थितियों के प्रति स्पष्ट भय या चिंता जहाँ से निकलना कठिन हो या सहायता उपलब्ध न हो

agoraphobia.mappingNote: ICD-11 Agoraphobia is 6B02; DSM Agoraphobia is diagnosed independently of Panic Disorder (MINI Module E).

description.en: Recurrent unexpected panic attacks
description.hi: बार-बार अप्रत्याशित घबराहट के दौरे

description.en: Intense fear of social situations and being judged
description.hi: सामाजिक स्थितियों और आंके जाने का तीव्र डर

social_anxiety.mappingNote: ICD-11 Social anxiety disorder is 6B04; 6B00.1 is GAD with mild/moderate somatic symptoms.

description.en: Symptoms following exposure to traumatic event
description.hi: आघातजनक घटना के संपर्क में आने के बाद लक्षण

ptsd.mappingNote: ICD-11 PTSD is 6B40; Complex PTSD (6B41) has no separately named DSM-5-TR diagnosis. DSM acute stress disorder is not equivalent to ICD acute stress reaction (QE84), which sits outside Chapter 06 (index 6.1.2-6.1.3).

name.hi: जटिल आघात के बाद तनाव विकार

complex_ptsd.dsm5: No separately named DSM-5-TR diagnosis (compared with PTSD with dissociative or delayed expression)

description.en: PTSD with additional emotional regulation and self-concept disturbances
description.hi: अतिरिक्त भावनात्मक नियमन और आत्म-अवधारणा गड़बड़ी के साथ PTSD

complex_ptsd.mappingNote: ICD-11 Complex PTSD (6B41) has no identically named DSM-5-TR diagnosis; assess each system's criteria independently (index 6.1.3).

description.en: Difficulty initiating or maintaining sleep
description.hi: नींद शुरू करने या बनाए रखने में कठिनाई

insomnia.mappingNote: ICD-11 chronic insomnia is 7A00 and short-term insomnia 7A01 (Chapter 07, Sleep-wake disorders); DSM Insomnia Disorder spans both. Select by duration per ICD requirements (index 11.1.2).

description.en: Persistent pattern of inattention and/or hyperactivity-impulsivity
description.hi: ध्यान की कमी और/या अतिसक्रियता-आवेगशीलता का लगातार पैटर्न

adhd.mappingNote: ICD-11 ADHD is 6A05 with presentation subdivisions: predominantly inattentive 6A05.0, predominantly hyperactive-impulsive 6A05.1, combined 6A05.2 (index 1.4.2).

description.en: Angry/irritable mood, argumentative/defiant behaviour or vindictiveness toward authority figures
description.hi: प्राधिकार व्यक्तियों के प्रति क्रोधित/चिड़चिड़ा मूड, बहस करने वाला/अवज्ञाकारी व्यवहार या बदले की भावना

oppositional_defiant_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 Oppositional defiant disorder is 6C90; 6C91 is Conduct-dissocial disorder.

description.en: Repetitive pattern violating the rights of others or age-appropriate societal norms
description.hi: दूसरों के अधिकारों या आयु-उपयोज्य सामाजिक मानदंडों का उल्लंघन करने का पुनरावृत्ति पैटर्न

description.en: Problematic pattern of alcohol use leading to impairment
description.hi: शराब के उपयोग की समस्याग्रस्त पैटर्न जिससे हानि होती है

alcohol_use_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 Disorders due to use of alcohol is the 6C40 family (harmful use 6C40.0, dependence 6C40.2, intoxication 6C40.3, withdrawal 6C40.4, psychotic disorder 6C40.6); DSM Alcohol Use Disorder is a single graded diagnosis. Assess each system independently; 'use disorder' is not automatically equivalent to ICD dependence (index 14.1.2, operational rule on coding specificity).

description.en: Persistent psychotic symptoms including delusions and hallucinations
description.hi: भ्रम और मतिभ्रम सहित लगातार मनोवैज्ञानिक लक्षण

schizophrenia.mappingNote: ICD-11 Schizophrenia is 6A20 within the 6A20-6A24 primary psychotic grouping (6A21 schizoaffective, 6A22 schizotypal, 6A23 acute and transient psychotic, 6A24 delusional). DSM schizophreniform and brief psychotic disorders do not map automatically to 6A23 (index 2.1.2-2.1.3).

bipolar_depressive.dsm5: Bipolar II Disorder, current episode depressed
bipolar_depressive.mappingNote: ICD-11 Bipolar type II disorder is 6A61; episode, psychosis and remission subdivisions are selected separately (e.g. 6A60.x series for type I) and do not denote generic mixed/remission states (index 3.1.2).

adjustment_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 Adjustment disorder is 6B43, within the 6B42-6B45 trauma/stressor block together with prolonged grief disorder 6B42, reactive attachment disorder 6B44 and disinhibited social engagement disorder 6B45 (index 6.2.2).

hypersomnolence.mappingNote: ICD-11 Chapter 07 has no 7A10; the closest group is chronic hypersomnolence (7A20 Narcolepsy, 7A21 Idiopathic hypersomnia, 7A23 Other hypersomnia, 7A24 hypersomnia due to medication/substance). Assessed independently per index 11.1.2.

sleep_apnea.mappingNote: ICD-11 Obstructive sleep apnoea is 7A41; central sleep apnoeas are 7A40 and sleep-related hypoventilation or hypoxemia disorders 7A42, all in Chapter 07 (index 11.2.2).

circadian_rhythm.mappingNote: ICD-11 circadian rhythm sleep-wake disorders are 7A60-7A65 (7A60 delayed sleep-wake phase disorder shown as the representative child); 7A02 does not exist.

substance_use_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 separates stimulant families: Disorders due to use of cocaine is 6C45; disorders due to use of amphetamines, methamphetamine or methcathinone is 6C46 (Appendix A §14.2.2). DSM Stimulant Use Disorder maps to whichever substance-specific family applies; select the specific code rather than a generic parent.

psychotic_disorder.dsm5: Psychotic Disorder Not Otherwise Specified (MINI Module K screen)

description.en: Psychotic symptoms (delusions, hallucinations, disorganized speech/behavior, negative symptoms) not attributable to a mood episode or organic cause
description.hi: मनर्विकारी लक्षण (भ्रम, मतिभ्रम, अव्यवस्थित वाणी/व्यवहार, नकारात्मक लक्षण) जो मूड-एपिसोड या जैविक कारण पर निर्भर नहीं

psychotic_disorder.mappingNote: MINI Module K screens for psychotic disorders generically; the specific ICD-11 category (6A20-6A24 or 6A2Z/6A2Y) is determined by further clinical assessment.

mood_disorder_with_psychotic_features.dsm5: Major Depressive or Bipolar Disorder With Psychotic Features

description.en: Delusions or hallucinations occurring exclusively during major depressive, manic, or hypomanic episodes
description.hi: प्रमुख अवसादी, मैैनिक या हाइपोमैैनिक एपिसोड के दौरान ही उत्पन्न भ्रम या मतिभ्रम

mood_disorder_with_psychotic_features.mappingNote: MINI Module K separates psychosis restricted to mood episodes from primary psychotic disorder; ICD-11 encodes psychotic features within the mood-disorder chapter rather than 6A20-6A24.

schizoaffective.mappingNote: ICD-11 Schizoaffective disorder is 6A21; 6A22 is Schizotypal disorder.

brief_psychotic.mappingNote: DSM brief psychotic disorder has no automatic ICD equivalent (see index 2.1.3); 6A23 Acute and transient psychotic disorder is a comparison only, and 6A23.Y is used as the other-specified comparator.

delusional_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 Delusional disorder is 6A24 within the 6A20-6A24 primary psychotic grouping; DSM delusional disorder and ICD 6A24 share a label but duration, symptom and exclusion requirements differ - assess each system independently (index 2.1.1-2.1.3).

description.en: Obsessions and compulsions consuming more than one hour per day
description.hi: प्रतिदिन एक घंटे से अधिक समय लेने वाले द्वेष-विचार और बाध्यताएँ

ocd.mappingNote: ICD-11 OCD is 6B20, the parent of the 6B20-6B25 obsessive-compulsive-related family (body dysmorphic 6B21, olfactory reference 6B22, hypochondriasis 6B23, hoarding 6B24, body-focused repetitive behaviour 6B25) (index 5.1.2).

description.en: Restriction of energy intake with intense fear of weight gain
description.hi: वजन बढ़ने के तीव्र डर के साथ ऊर्जा-सेवन का प्रतिबंध

eating_anorexia.mappingNote: ICD-11 Anorexia nervosa is 6B80 within the 6B80-6B85 feeding/eating family (bulimia 6B81, binge eating 6B82, ARFID 6B83, pica 6B84, rumination-regurgitation 6B85) (index 9.1.2, 9.2.2).

description.en: Recurrent binge eating with compensatory behaviours to prevent weight gain
description.hi: बार-बार अतिभक्षण और वजन बढ़ने रोकने हेतु क्षतिपूर्ति व्यवहार

eating_bulimia.mappingNote: ICD-11 Bulimia nervosa is 6B81 within the 6B80-6B85 feeding/eating family (anorexia 6B80, binge eating 6B82, ARFID 6B83, pica 6B84, rumination-regurgitation 6B85) (index 9.1.2, 9.2.2); severity and remission qualifiers are selected separately.

description.en: Recurrent binge eating without regular compensatory behaviours, with marked distress
description.hi: नियमित क्षतिपूर्ति-व्यवहार के बिना बार-बार अतिभक्षण, महत्वपूर्ण कष्ट सहित

eating_binge_eating.mappingNote: ICD-11 Binge-eating disorder is 6B82 within the 6B80-6B85 feeding/eating family (index 9.1.2, 9.2.2). DSM requires weekly binges for 3 months; ICD-11 frequency/duration requirements differ - assess each system independently.

description.en: Pervasive disregard for and violation of the rights of others since age 15
description.hi: 15 वर्ष की आयु से दूसरों के अधिकारों की व्यापक अवहेलना एवं उल्लंघन

antisocial_personality_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 does not carry a distinct Antisocial Personality Disorder category; the closest comparison is 6D12 Dissociality pattern qualifier within personality disorder diagnosis (severity must be established first, Rule 5). bipolar_i_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 Bipolar type I disorder is 6A60; current episode, psychosis and remission subdivisions are selected separately (index 3.1.2) and do not denote generic mixed/remission states.

bipolar_ii_disorder.mappingNote: ICD-11 Bipolar type II disorder is 6A61; episode, psychosis and remission subdivisions are selected separately (index 3.1.2).

other_specified_bipolar.dsm5: Other Specified Bipolar and Related Disorder

description.hi: द्विध्रुवी-स्पेक्ट्रम प्रस्तुतियाँ जो पूर्ण मानदंड पूरे किए बिना हानि जनती हैं

other_specified_bipolar.mappingNote: DSM other specified bipolar categories map to ICD-11 6A6Y Other specified bipolar or related disorder; short-duration hypomanic/manic episodes and cyclothymia have different thresholds across systems - assess each independently (index 3.1.2).

personality_borderline.mappingNote: Personality disorder must be established with severity before trait/pattern qualifiers (Rule 5). Moderate personality disorder 6D10.1 with Borderline pattern qualifier 6D11.5; 6D11 alone is not an assignable diagnosis and 6D11.0 denotes Negative affectivity.

schizophrenia_spectrum.mappingNote: ICD-11 uses .Z for unspecified categories (Schizophrenia spectrum and other primary psychotic disorders, unspecified = 6A2Z); there is no 6A2Y in this block.

dissociative.mappingNote: ICD-11 Dissociative identity disorder is 6B64; 6B11 does not exist in the dissociative block (6B60-6B66).

description.hi: कष्ट या हानि उत्पन्न करने वाली असामान्य यौन रुचियाँ

paraphilic.mappingNote: ICD-11 paraphilic disorders are 6D30-6D36 plus 6D3Z; there are no separately named MMS categories for fetishistic disorder, transvestic disorder or sexual masochism disorder - consider 6D36 only when its requirements are met (index 17.1.2).

factitious.mappingNote: ICD-11 Factitious disorder imposed on self is 6D50 (6D51 imposed on another, 6D5Z unspecified); 6E61 is Secondary psychotic syndrome.

somatic.mappingNote: ICD-11 Bodily distress disorder is 6C20; 6B42 is Prolonged grief disorder. Related construct, not identical criteria set (index 8.1.2).
